messages.subject: Okafor — draft ET3 grounds of resistance for approval
messages.plaintextBody:
Daniel,

Attached is the draft ET3 grounds of resistance for your approval ahead of the 24 March deadline. Key points:

- We admit redundancy as the reason for dismissal (a potentially fair reason) and deny the disclosures were the reason or principal reason.
- We do not, for these proceedings, dispute that the June/July communications were capable of being qualifying disclosures — fighting that point is not worth it and the focus should be causation.
- We take a time-limit point on the pre-27 November detriments.

Please let me have any comments by end of tomorrow so we can serve in good time.

Tom

Tom Gallagher
Associate | Employment & Litigation
Whitfield Carter LLP
T +44 (0)20 7946 0834

Confidential and may be legally privileged.
